_comment: R32/R40 for the console half of contracts v2. One single-edit mutant per invariant the v2 suites claim. `node tests/contracts/v2/run-mutants-v2.mjs` applies each to a temporary copy of lib/contracts plus the v2 suites and the Python fixture directory, and requires it to be killed by a NAMED test — a non-zero exit alone is not a kill, and a load, syntax, stripping or timeout failure is a runner error that fails the run. Compile-time invariants (the disjoint unit brands) are not in this list: they are checked by the `@ts-expect-error` blocks in money-units.test.ts under `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`, which no runtime mutant can express.

mutants.note: an unknown unit token is accepted instead of refused
cases: a wrong or unknown unit token is refused, since the brand is gone at runtime

mutants.note: an unknown accounting regime is accepted
cases: the accounting regime fixes the unit and an unknown regime refuses

mutants.note: the legacy regime is mapped to CREDIT
cases: the accounting regime fixes the unit and an unknown regime refuses
a mixed history totals per unit and refuses a regime/unit mismatch

mutants.note: an out-of-domain total is returned instead of refused
mutants.find: if (sum === null) throw new RangeError(`${unit} total overflows numeric(20, 8)`);
mutants.replace: if (false) throw new RangeError(`${unit} total overflows numeric(20, 8)`);
cases: same-unit arithmetic is exact at eight places and overflow throws

mutants.note: a non-canonical decimal is accepted as canonical
cases: the surface and schema version are declared once, and canonical form is exact

mutants.note: credits are displayed with a currency symbol
cases: credits are displayed as credits, never with a currency symbol

mutants.note: the parity table is classified by a looser grammar
mutants.replace: return String(value) as unknown as T;
cases: the generated money-unit table is classified exactly as Python classifies it

mutants.note: available credit is the stored counter rather than a derivation
cases: available credit is recomputed, not trusted

mutants.note: a consumer entitlement is claimed for every wallet kind
cases: the committed wallet fixtures type-check as the console's DTOs

mutants.note: a regime/unit mismatch is read instead of refused
cases: a mixed history totals per unit and refuses a regime/unit mismatch

mutants.note: the dollar total is reported under the CREDIT key
cases: a mixed history totals per unit and refuses a regime/unit mismatch
